from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/53023/1_53023_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/53023_0_345f2112/1_53023_output.xlsx")

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

day = str(ws["B11"].value).strip()
person = str(ws["C11"].value).strip()

matched_cost = None
# The reference table used by the original formula is I4:I8 for lookup text and K4:K8 for cost.
for row in range(4, 9):
    lookup_text = ws.cell(row=row, column=9).value  # column I
    if lookup_text is None:
        continue
    lookup_norm = str(lookup_text).lower()
    if day.lower() in lookup_norm and person.lower() in lookup_norm:
        matched_cost = ws.cell(row=row, column=11).value  # column K
        break

if matched_cost is None:
    raise ValueError(f"No matching cost found for day={day!r} and person={person!r} in I4:I8.")

# Cell-level manipulation: only modify the requested answer cell F11.
ws["F11"] = matched_cost

wb.save(output_path)
print(f"Saved {output_path}")
print("F11 =", ws["F11"].value)
